name: versus-match
description: Versus fighting (WM_ROM_OUT/versus of rom.test.tsx, rom/versusFixture.ts: one screen with a floor), phases 1 and 2. Player 1, steered by a bot in play mode (its inputs, frame by frame: it backs off blocking as each round starts, blocks the CPU's near attacks or ducks a punch now and then, steps in, kicks from afar and punches close every 3 frames, and now and then throws a fireball (down, down-toward, toward and B1) from afar or dashes (away, toward and B1) from mid range) fights the CPU, which closes in, attacks every 20 frames, blocks, and throws a fireball from afar a third of the way into each 90 frames; fireballs at frames 275, 3561, 3575; round 2 from frame 3428; two rounds won clear the level. Play mode gives both fighters' place, health and score every frame.
